description: A feedback offer waits (Send this to the makers) and he says 'yes send it': the tutor takes it as a confirm, says in a sentence that it is done and promises nothing.

history.q: Can I read the ESV beside the Greek?
history.a: Lampas does not have the ESV. I can pass your wish to the makers; I cannot say what they will decide.

pending_offer.text: He wants the ESV to read beside the Greek.
